name: iter_showcase_search
description: SHOWCASE SEARCH - the whole-area guided advantage under persistent scarcity is real but geometrically bounded: gap ~ area_frac x in-weakspot error cut, and at radius 0.25 the weakspot is only ~15% of the area, so the confirmed in-weakspot lead buys just ~-0.02 whole-area MAE. This sweep multiplies the bound instead of fighting it: a larger induced gap (radius 0.35, ~38% of the square) raises area_frac, a narrower selection kernel (sigma 0.15/0.3) concentrates the harvest on the rare in-gap candidates, and a higher mix (0.75) spends more of the round's budget on them - each crossed with the two policies that survive scarcity (Constant, Adaptive severity) at deficit 0.9 / 0.98. Fixed at the confirmed cell otherwise: n_train 30, n_select 100, K=8, 15 seeds.
